raw.rationale: Midostaurin is a multikinase inhibitor with potent activity against FLT3 and KIT, so selective killing is most likely in lineages with oncogenic FLT3 or KIT dependencies, especially AML (not listed) and possibly KIT-driven gastrointestinal stromal tumors (not listed); among the listed lineages, only a few have known KIT/FLT3 dependencies or transporter/lineage contexts that could yield selective sensitivity, and most lineages should have very low probability.
